groups.name: Sample sheet
groups.help: These four fields become one row of configs/samples.tsv and drive every step.

fields.label: Sample ID
fields.help: Short name, letters/digits/underscore only. Used for file names, e.g. dsDNA_r1.

fields.label: SRA run accession
fields.help: Leave empty if you provide your own FASTQ instead.

fields.label: Condition
fields.help: What was done to the cells, e.g. rnp_dsDNA_donor.

fields.label: Negative control
fields.help: Tick for mock / untreated samples. CRISPRLungo uses the first ticked sample as its control.

groups.name: Sequencing
groups.help: Recorded in configs/samples/<sample_id>.json. Not used by the tools, kept for provenance.

fields.label: Local FASTQ (if no SRA run)
fields.help: Absolute path to a gzipped FASTQ. Copied to data/<sample_id>.fastq.gz by step 03.

fields.label: Cell type
fields.help: e.g. primary human T cells, donor 3
